items.title: ‘Robot Olympics’ reveal humanoids’ rapid progress — and flaws
items.description: Nature, Published online: 27 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02713-zHumanoid robots broke records at sporting events such as sprints, but struggled at practical tasks such as hammering nails.

items.title: Automated prototyping of genetic codes
items.description: Nature, Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10949-yA robotic, cell–free platform rapidly prototypes redesigned genetic codes, enabling the translation of proteins with reassigned codons and non-standard amino acids without altering living genomes.
